verdicts.reason: A: the 'Build Your Mix' CTA has shrunk to a tiny chip at the top-right, crammed in with the flavour pills on top of the decorative circle. It sits above the headline, so the reading order is backwards. The legal line has been promoted to a subhead and is larger than the CTA. B: the headline and can split is better and the CTA sits at the bottom, but the pills are scattered across ragged rows. The CTA and pill text are so small they can't be read, the CTA shares a row with two pills, and the legal line is again promoted to a subhead. A is slightly less broken because its text can still be read and its tag cluster at least looks grouped.
